I’m willing to catch 12 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree before choosing. Otherwise, I’ll catch 10.

Emma, I support reviewing the stock each month, but one clarification: leaving half guarantees a return to 100 only when we start at 100. From 80, catching 40 leaves 40, which doubles to just 80 if external replenishment fails. We should base any future agreement on the actual stock and always leave at least 5 tons.

Jack, would you join the conditional 12-ton agreement?
